name: SingleTableInheritance
summary: A hierarchy of classes mapped to one table holding the columns of all of them.

roles.name: SingleTableInheritance
roles.summary: The root of a hierarchy stored in a single table, with a discriminator and a column per field of every subclass. Simple and fast — no joins, no scattered rows — at the price of columns that are null for most rows, and a table that grows every time a subclass gains a field.
